title: Seminal
summary: SEM'INAL, adjective [Latin seminalis, from semen, seed; from the root of sow.] 1. Pertaining to seed, or to the elements of production. 2. Contained in a seed; radical; rudimental; original; as semina

inlines.v: SEM'INAL, adjective [Latin seminalis, from semen, seed; from the root of sow.] 1. Pertaining to seed, or to the elements of production. 2. Contained in a seed; radical; rudimental; original; as seminal principles of generation; seminal virtue. Seminal leaf, the same as seed-leaf. SEM'INAL, noun seminal state.
